name: South Indian
summary: South Indian is a [[kind:landrace|landrace]] associated with Kerala, [[country:IN|India]], one of the four traditional parents usually named for [[haze|Haze]]. Accounts differ on whether it contributed a sativa or an indica-leaning plant to that cross. Flowering for equatorial South Indian landraces runs roughly 14 to 19 weeks.

sources.title: Where Did Haze Cannabis Come From?
The Diverse Indian Landraces
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms Kerala as a South Indian landrace region and a roughly 95–130 day (about 14–19 week) flowering window.
